limits: Diagnostic only, never product acceptance. Callback receipt origins are upper bounds, not synchronized presentation clocks or physical speaker onset. Shared coverage uses each actual first packet plus saved frame duration, without padding. Matches prove saved PCM identity only; two missing captures cannot identify app versus common capture/output loss. Source silence, unobserved boundaries and queued unplayed tail receive no waveform credit. No listening, transcript, quality, startup, memory or M3 claim.
